stays.note: Parents' house, Heerenstraat A 1173 (now Herenstraat 23/23bis), Utrecht; let176 (15 Oct) discusses his still-pending plan to go to Brussels
Second winter course at the Brussels Academy; rooms at rue Lombard 17
evidence: inferred: left after let176 (15 Oct, plans still pending; visited Etten en route per let178 n.9) and was back in the Netherlands by let195 (30 Dec); exact dates unknown

stays.note: Parents' house and studio, Heerenstraat A 1173 (now Herenstraat 23/23bis). Summer 1885: working on the Ruimzicht brickyard painting at Jutphaas just south of Utrecht (let529 n.4, let531); then to Terschelling (let529)
With L.W.R. Wenckebach, 'July-August 1882' (let516 n.2). Caveat: let257 (14 Aug) says 'He has been to Drenthe', so he may already have been back in Utrecht when let256 (13 Aug) was written
Health cure at Soden, Germany, 'July and August 1883' (let290 n.8); let359 (3 Jul) written 'while you're travelling'; back and visiting Vincent in The Hague shortly before 21 Aug (let378)

Walking tour across the Hondsrug with Wenckebach, early July to end Sept 1884 (let454 n.1). Conflicts with let378 n.6 (Terschelling July-Sept 1884) and let460 (letter from Terschelling c. 19-21 Sept); late-Sept letters are pinned to Terschelling below

let459.note: Vincent assumed Drenthe, but Van Rappard's letter from Terschelling crossed this one (let460)

evidence: inferred: n.5 places him on Terschelling until the end of September; letter dated c. 24-29 Sept 1884
